DETOX

DETOX

TREATMENT

• Toxin Removal • Reduced Fluid Retention • Improved Circulation • Stress Relief •

“Renew and Revitalize with Detox Massage at

CASTLE SPA AND MASSAGE”

Detox Treatment

Detox Massage stimulates the lymphatic system to eliminate toxins, using gentle strokes to encourage fluid removal. Targeted techniques release muscle tension, enhancing relaxation and detoxification.

60 minutes          $250

FAQs

Detox Massage focuses on stimulating the lymphatic system and promoting detoxification, while regular massages often aim to address muscle tension and promote relaxation. Detox Massage uses specific techniques to support the body’s natural detox processes.

The frequency of Detox Massage sessions can vary depending on your individual needs and wellness goals. For optimal results, a series of sessions may be recommended initially, followed by maintenance sessions as desired.

Hot Spring

“Healing Radiance with Infrared Light Therapy at

infrared light

15 minutes          $30
30 minutes          $60
